name: wordpress-block-design-compiler
description: Agent workflow and tools for designing HTML mockups, compiling them into editable WordPress blocks, and iterating with visual diffs.

interface.shortDescription: Design HTML sites and compile them into editable WordPress blocks.
interface.longDescription: A staged agent workflow for generating high-quality HTML/CSS/JS mockups, planning core/custom WordPress blocks, generating vanilla JS custom blocks, assembling block content, and iterating with screenshot diffs until visual fidelity is high.
interface.defaultPrompt: Transform this HTML/site request into editable WordPress blocks with the HTML-to-blocks workflow.
